lines.en: : I will be fine on my own from this point on. Thank you, Master Geoffrey.
lines.zh: : 从现在起，我一个人也没问题了。谢谢你，Geoffrey 师父。

lines.en: Tsuneyo closes her eyes. They were open just a second ago. She sinks her blade into a carrot. It was whole just a second ago. You enter the room. You were nowhere just a second ago.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 闭上眼睛。就在一秒前它们还睁着。她把刀刃插进一根胡萝卜里。就在一秒前它还是完整的。你走进房间。就在一秒前你还不在任何地方。

lines.en: Her eyes open once more. You need to do that when you have a knife in your hand. But she wouldn’t have a knife in her hand for much longer because it was time to go on a trip.
lines.zh: 她又一次睁开眼睛。手里拿着刀的时候，你得这么做。不过她手里拿着刀的时间不会太久了，因为该出发去旅行了。

lines.en: Past the world of worldliness (where our world normally is) and into a plane of unworldliness, categorized by its humidity and 29-hour time cycle.
lines.zh: 越过世俗之界（我们的世界平时就在那儿），进入一片脱俗之境——以湿度和 29 小时的时间循环为其特征。

lines.en: Far beyond the infinity house, something was happening. The cats had come out to play. It was time for {b}ELATION PROTOCOL.{/b}
lines.zh: 在无限之屋的更远方，有什么事正在发生。猫儿们出来玩耍了。是时候启动{b}欢腾协议{/b}了。

lines.en: But what is that, you ask?
lines.zh: 可那是什么，你问？
它是。

lines.en: She blinks. A necessary human function.
lines.zh: 她眨了眨眼。一项必要的人体机能。

lines.en: : I wonder if I will have any time left once I have finished cooking to enjoy the festivities with my many acquaintances and one friend.
lines.zh: : 不知道等我把菜做完，还有没有时间跟我那许多熟人和唯一一个朋友一起享受节日。

lines.en: : But I must diligently finish the task at hand — for the greatest chefs know when and when not to provide their mind with a lane to wander through.
lines.zh: : 但我必须认真把手头这件事做完——因为最伟大的厨师都懂得，什么时候该给自己的心留一条可以游荡的小路，什么时候不该。

lines.en: : Right now, I am focused. I am a warrior of the culinary arts. I am Tsuneyo Tojo — future sole proprietor of Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 此刻我很专注。我是烹饪之道的战士。我是 Tsuneyo Tojo——Tojo 拉面店未来的唯一继承人。
或者说现在就是！

lines.en: The smell had gotten worse//but the power issues finally managed to resolve themselves. Probably. At least I haven’t seen any in quite some time.
lines.zh: 气味变得更糟了//不过供电问题总算自己解决了。大概吧。至少我已经有一阵子没见到它们了。

lines.en: But I’m just like you. I’ve never seen what lies beyond that door. I’ve only dreamt of it. And there is not much to do but let those dreams consume me until my curiosity finally reaches its climax.
lines.zh: 但我和你一样。我从未见过那扇门后面是什么。我只梦见过它。而在好奇心终于抵达顶点之前，除了让那些梦把我吞掉，也没有别的事可做。
: 唔，那可真奇怪。

lines.en: : Is someone there? I was informed that I’d be able to work in peace.
lines.zh: : 有人在吗？我被告知可以在这里安静地工作。

lines.en: : This area is off limits to those who-
lines.zh: : 这一带禁止——

lines.en: : Sticks and stones may break my bones; I wish that they would hurt me.
lines.zh: : 棍棒与石头能打断我的骨头；我希望它们真的能伤到我。

lines.en: : He strokes my hair when we’re alone but he doesn’t deserve me-
lines.zh: : 我们独处时他会抚摸我的头发，可他配不上我——
: 在哪——

lines.en: : HIS HANDS SO LARGE THEY SWALLOW MINE, I SWALLOW TOO JUST WATCH. HE TOUCHES ME, HE TOUCHES THEM, HE MAKES US CLEAN HIS CROTCH.
lines.zh: : 他的手那么大，把我的手都吞没了，我也照样吞下去给你看。他碰我，他碰她们，他让我们替他清理裆部。

lines.en: : A POEM, A POEM, A PARASITE. I HEAR THE VOICE OF GOD. SIX MILLION WHISPERS DEEPER AND I’M STILL THE PEBBLE’S CLOD.
lines.zh: : 一首诗，一首诗，一个寄生虫。我听见了神的声音。六百万声低语再深一层，我依然是那颗卵石的土块。

lines.en: : {b}BELIEVING ISN’T SEEING SINCE BELIEVING ISN’T REAL. AND SEEING’S NOT BELIEVING ‘TIL YOU’VE SEEN YOURSELF IN HEELS.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}相信不是看见，因为相信并不真实。而看见也算不上相信，除非你见过自己穿上高跟鞋的样子。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}NO MATTER HOW YOU CUT IT AND NO MATTER HOW IT BLEEDS, YOU WILL ALWAYS BE THE NOODLE GIRL.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}不管你怎么切它，也不管它怎么流血，你永远都会是那个面条女孩。{/b}
: {b}{size=+20}因为那就是我们说好的。{/size}{/b}

lines.en: Tsuneyo Tojo falls into a pot of boiling water. She turns into a crayfish.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 掉进了一锅沸水里。她变成了一只小龙虾。

lines.en: And we just sit and watch because we ordered her for dinner.
lines.zh: 而我们只是坐着看，因为我们点了她当晚餐。

lines.en: Sticks and stones may break my bones//it’s time for your first h-scene
lines.zh: 棍棒与石头能打断我的骨头//是时候来你的第一场 H 场景了

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah. Get pregnant. Get pregnant. Take that dick. Get pregnant. Fuck. Get pregnant. Yeah. Get pregnant. Get pregnant. Get pregnant. Get pregnant.
lines.zh: : 对。对。怀孕吧。怀孕吧。把那根鸡巴吃下去。怀孕吧。操。怀孕吧。对。怀孕吧。怀孕吧。怀孕吧。怀孕吧。

lines.en: A beautiful scene, is it not? To see the things that you forgot. But halt before His crime’s alleged! The sharpening of Gallow’s Edge. The fear that pushed you from that ledge-
lines.zh: 多美的一幕啊，不是吗？看见那些你早已遗忘的东西。但在祂的罪行被指控之前先停下！绞架之锋正被磨利。那把你从悬崖边推开的恐惧——

lines.en: Did naught but strengthen a part of you that has always existed, just not in a form that’s easy to appreciate when taken out of context.
lines.zh: 只不过强化了那个一直存在于你体内的部分，只是它脱离语境之后，不那么容易被人欣赏罢了。

lines.en: You know it to be true, don’t you? You knew the truth and spoke it too! Yet no one understood or listened then. Would the same steps be followed now? Would you let those stares {i}become{/i} stairs?
lines.zh: 你知道这是真的，对吧？你早就知道真相，也把它说出口了！可当时没有一个人听得懂、也没有一个人在听。如今还会重走那些脚步吗？你会让那些注视{i}变成{/i}阶梯吗？

lines.en: : Or are you content with just playing with yourself in the dark at night because your thoughts don’t always make you {b}happy?{/b}
lines.zh: : 还是说，你甘愿在夜里独自摸自己，只因为你的念头并不总能让你{b}开心{/b}？

lines.en: : Oh, come on. There’s no need to be so quiet. You’re safe here. And I can guarantee you that {i}whatever{/i} it is you’re thinking isn’t even half as “bad” as the things I’ve done.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。没必要这么安静。你在这儿很安全。而且我敢保证，你心里{i}想的东西{/i}，还不及我做过的那些事一半「坏」。
: 他很美，对吧？Aki-kun。

lines.en: : You know, {i}I{/i} was the first person to ever suck that little wiener of his. Some might even say I taught him everything he knows.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，{i}我{/i}是第一个替他含过那根小香肠的人。甚至有人会说，他懂的全是我教的。

lines.en: : I guess it’s not very little anymore though, is it? {i}Now,{/i} he’s-
lines.zh: : 不过我想那玩意儿现在已经不怎么小了，对吧？{i}现在{/i}的他——
: 你是谁？

lines.en: : Oh! Sorry. Where are my manners? My name is Sekai. I believe you know my daughter, Ami!
lines.zh: : 哦！抱歉。我礼仪都到哪儿去了？我叫 Sekai。我想你认识我女儿，Ami！

lines.en: : Tell me — what’s she like in school? I have a hard time ghosting myself into that place and I want to make sure she’s well-behaved.
lines.zh: : 告诉我——她在学校里是什么样的？我很难把自己飘进那个地方，所以想确认她有没有乖乖的。
: 她……挺好的。

lines.en: : Great! Thanks for letting me know.
lines.zh: : 太好了！谢谢你的情报。
: 你在做什么？

lines.en: : Hey, aren’t these kind of huge for your age? Are you {i}sure{/i} you’re who you say you are? You’re positive you didn’t just lose track of time cooped up in that ramen shop?
lines.zh: : 嘿，以你的年纪来说，这些是不是有点太大了？你{i}确定{/i}你真是你自称的那个人？你确定自己不是在那家拉面店里憋久了、忘了时间？
: 你不能就这么……摸——
: Tsuneyo，对吧？

lines.en: : Listen, I don’t think you understand what’s going on right now, so I’m going to put this in the most gentle, easy-to-understand way possible.
lines.zh: : 听着，我觉得你并不明白现在发生了什么，所以我会用最温柔、最好懂的方式跟你说。

lines.en: : I’m going to help you have your first ever orgasm!
lines.zh: : 我要帮你迎来人生第一次高潮！

lines.en: : And there’s nothing you can do about it since you’ve fallen into my golden noodle trap!
lines.zh: : 而且你拿这个没办法，因为你已经掉进了我的黄金面陷阱！
: 嗯啊！我不能——

lines.en: : Yeah, moving’s not going to work. But you can trust me! I know what I’m doing. And soon, you won’t even {i}want{/i} to move! That’s just how good I am.
lines.zh: : 对，动是没用的。不过你可以相信我！我知道我在做什么。而且很快，你就连动都不{i}想{/i}动了！我就有这么厉害。

lines.en: : Why are you doing this?! Where am I?! I demand you-
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这么做？！我这是在哪儿？！我要求你——

lines.en: : D’awwww, look at you making demands. Tell you what! You manage to break free from the golden noodle trap, and I’ll send you right back to that kitchen! You’re the strong one, right? I say you go for it!
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀，看看你，还提上要求了。这样吧！你要是能挣脱黄金面陷阱，我就立刻送你回那间厨房！你不是那个坚强的人吗？我说你就试试看啊！
: 嗯……唔嗯！我的手臂——

lines.en: : Weird, right? They’re not restrained at all, yet you can’t seem to remember how to use them. Do you want to know why?
lines.zh: : 很奇怪吧？它们根本没被绑住，可你就是想不起来该怎么用。想知道为什么吗？

lines.en: : I want to know...why you’re doing this! I have...never even seen you before!
lines.zh: : 我想知道的是……你为什么要这么做！我……从来没见过你！

lines.en: : Duh. I’m dead. You’d be, like, totally crazy if you {i}were{/i} seeing me around. As for {i}why{/i} I’m doing this, though...
lines.zh: : 废话。我死了。你要是能到处看见我，那才叫彻底疯了。至于我{i}为什么{/i}要这么做嘛……

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I said it was for your own good?
lines.zh: : 如果我说这是为了你好，你会信吗？
: 我现在……什么都无法相信……

lines.en: : None of this...seems real...I just...wanted to cook...
lines.zh: : 这一切……都不像是真的……我只是……想做饭……

lines.en: : Yeaaaah, that’s kind of the problem. That’s all you {i}ever{/i} want to do. And being so far into the game already without any sex in sight, it’s time for {i}me{/i} to step in and put you on the right path!
lines.zh: : 是——啊，问题就在这儿。那就是你唯一想做的事。而游戏都已经进行到这么深了，连个爱的影子都没有，是时候由{i}我{/i}出面把你引上正路了！

lines.en: : You’ve been thinking about it, haven’t you? Your curiosity has taken root! Your dreams are full of Aki-kun’s cock! Yet you’re further away from him than ever before!
lines.zh: : 你一直在想那件事，对吧？你的好奇心已经扎了根！你的梦里全是 Aki-kun 的鸡巴！可你却比以往任何时候都离他更远！

lines.en: : Is it because you’re scared? Nervous? Because there’s really no need to be. Just look at your friend over there! Sex is so easy that she can do it in her sleep!
lines.zh: : 是因为害怕吗？紧张吗？因为真的没必要。看看你那边那位朋友就知道了！性爱简单到她睡着都能做！

lines.en: : But the Emerald Guardian...claims that...nothing happened that night!
lines.zh: : 可是翡翠守护者……声称……那天晚上什么都没发生！

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} claim to a be a law-abiding citizen who {i}only{/i} likes older boys.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}声称自己是个守法的公民，{i}只{/i}喜欢年长的男孩。

lines.en: : It does not matter what you claim! This is...clearly fictional! I wish for this nightmare to end...now!
lines.zh: : 你声称什么根本不重要！这一切……显然是虚构的！我希望这场噩梦……现在就结束！

lines.en: : I know for a fact that’s not true, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我知道那不是真的，Tsuneyo。
: 你怎么——

lines.en: : I know because {i}you’re{/i} the one who created this world.
lines.zh: : 我知道，因为是{i}你{/i}创造了这个世界。

lines.en: : If you dream a dream within a dream, it’s hard to tell what’s true. And if you dream a dream in one of those, who {i}knows{/i} what you can do?
lines.zh: : 如果你在梦里做了一个梦，就很难分清什么是真的。而如果你在其中一个梦里又做了一个梦，{i}谁知道{/i}你能做出什么事来？
: 我……不明白……

lines.en: : You’re a good girl who wants to do bad things. And I’m a bad girl who wants to do good things. Together, we can make one whole person.
lines.zh: : 你是个想做坏事的好女孩。而我是个想做好事的坏女孩。合在一起，我们就能凑成一个完整的人。

lines.en: : Think of me like a wet dream — the climax you’ve been hunting, yet haven’t managed to find.
lines.zh: : 把我当成一场春梦吧——你一直在猎捕、却始终没能找到的那个高潮。

lines.en: : This is a real honor, you know. I normally just hang out in the background. But I’ve been swimming through the sea of consciousness for long enough to know that you kinda {i}need{/i} to do this or...
lines.zh: : 这可是莫大的荣幸，你知道吗。我平时只在背景里待着。但在意识之海里游了这么久，我已经足够清楚你{i}非做这件事不可{/i}，否则……

lines.en: : Well, I’m not really sure what will happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也不太确定会发生什么。

lines.en: : But I can tell you it won’t be good!
lines.zh: : 但我可以告诉你，那不会是什么好事！

lines.en: : You probably wish it was you instead, don’t you? How unfair it must be to have your best friend getting dicked down while {i}you{/i} struggle to figure out how to even take care of yourself!
lines.zh: : 你大概希望那个人是自己吧？看着最好的朋友被鸡巴干，而{i}你{/i}自己连怎么照顾自己都还没弄明白，多不公平啊！

lines.en: : You aren’t being haunted by me — you’re being haunted by the past. Just like Aki-kun was until I gave him a much needed wakeup call.
lines.zh: : 缠着你的不是我——是过去。就像 Aki-kun 一直被过去缠着，直到我给了他一记急需的当头棒喝。

lines.en: : I can make it all go away. His scent on her clothes. Those visions of that man planting a tree. Those visions of your {i}father{/i} because you’re fascinated by dicks but haven’t been exposed to many yet.
lines.zh: : 我能让这一切都消失。他留在她衣服上的气味。那个男人种树的幻象。那些关于你{i}父亲{/i}的幻象——因为你对鸡巴很着迷，只是还没怎么见过。

lines.en: : How’s he doing, by the way? Probably bad, right?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，他现在怎么样？大概不太好，对吧？
: 你……认识我父亲？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I was a regular at that place back when I was younger. I would’ve whored myself out for that tori shio ramen if it wasn’t already so damn cheap.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。我年轻时可是那家店的常客。要是那碗盐味鸡汤拉面不是本来就便宜得要命，我怕是早就为了它把自己给卖了。
: 我……好像……想起了什么……
: 那就别想了。

lines.en: : We have better things to do.
lines.zh: : 我们有更要紧的事要做。

lines.en: : I died before I ever got to pay my tab.
lines.zh: : 我没能付清账单就死了。

lines.en: The snow was cold because it was snow.
lines.zh: 雪很冷，因为那是雪。
: 诸位听好！诸位听好！

lines.en: : On this hallowed eve of remembrance, I am joined by Tsuneyo Tojo — daughter of Tojo Ramen’s sole proprietor and the girl who will one day hang herself with his mantle!
lines.zh: : 在这个值得纪念的万圣夜，我有幸与 Tsuneyo Tojo 同席——Tojo 拉面店唯一继承人的女儿，也是那个终有一天会用自己的衣钵上吊的女孩！

lines.en: : Please...do not do this. Your “tab” is forgiven. {i}I’m not ready.{/i}
lines.zh: : 请……不要这样。您那笔「账」我免了。{i}我还没准备好{/i}。

lines.en: : You want to back out {i}now?!{/i} After I went through the effort of dressing like your husband?! Tsuneyo, how could you?!
lines.zh: : {i}事到临头{/i}你想退缩？！我可是费了那么大劲才打扮成你丈夫的样子啊！Tsuneyo，你怎么能这样？！

lines.en: : I was never on board for such contact in the first place! I already told you, I just wanted to cook!
lines.zh: : 我从一开始就没同意过这种接触！我早就说过了，我只是想做饭！

lines.en: : But I worked so hard on all of those knots!
lines.zh: : 可我为了打那些结花了多少心思啊！

lines.en: : I don’t even remember you tying-
lines.zh: : 我都不记得你绑过——
: 嗯啊！

lines.en: : Okay, great. Nice and secure. I got rid of the golden noodle trap since I’ll be on my knees in a second and didn’t want to risk falling into it again.
lines.zh: : 好了，很好。绑得又牢又稳。我把黄金面陷阱撤掉了，因为我一会儿要跪下来，可不想再一脚踩进去。

lines.en: : How’s it feel when I tug on this part? Good? It’s been a while since I’ve been tied up. I can’t really remember.
lines.zh: : 我扯这一下感觉怎么样？爽吗？我已经很久没被绑过了，实在想不太起来。

lines.en: : No? How about if I tug it harder?
lines.zh: : 不要？那我扯得更用力一点呢？
: 嗯唔唔！

lines.en: : Ah! There’s no denying that one, Tsuneyo. You’re totally getting turned on right now. This is probably the first time you’ve ever felt powerless, huh?
lines.zh: : 啊！这下可没法否认了，Tsuneyo。你现在完全来感觉了。这大概是你有生以来第一次体会到无能为力吧？

lines.en: : I beg you...please stop this...I can’t handle it...
lines.zh: : 求你了……请停下……我受不了了……

lines.en: : That’s cause you’re a naughty, slutty little slut! The prude kind! The {i}worst{/i} kind! Just give in already and start fucking Aki-kun like everybody else. It’s what you’re supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 因为你就是个下流、淫荡的小骚货！还是{i}最要命{/i}的那种假正经！干脆认了吧，开始像其他人一样跟 Aki-kun 上床。这本就是你该做的事。

lines.en: : What do you mean I’m...{i}supposed{/i} to?
lines.zh: : 什么叫……我{i}该{/i}做的？

lines.en: : My job is...providing food and...a place to rest for those who feel hungry and lost...
lines.zh: : 我的职责是……为那些饥饿又迷路的人……提供食物和一处歇脚的地方……
: 我从来……就只是这样……
: 可怜的东西。

lines.en: : You don’t even know what you are, do you?
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道自己是什么，对吧？
: 我是……一名战士……
: NNNGHGH！

lines.en: : What kind of “warrior” makes a noise like that?
lines.zh: : 哪有「战士」会发出那种声音的？

lines.en: : You’re a toy just like the rest. Just because you came in a nicer box doesn’t mean it’s right to expect you won’t ever be taken out of it.
lines.zh: : 你跟其他货色一样是个玩具。只不过你装在一个更漂亮的盒子里，不代表别人就该指望你永远不会被拿出来。
